name: v2.8.0
body:
## v2.8.0 [2026-04-22]
----------------------

In addition to the list of changes below, please also see the [official release notes] (https://docs.influxdata.com/influxdb/v2/reference/release-notes/influx-cli/#v280) for other important information about this release.


### Bug Fixes

- [929952d](https://github.com/influxdata/influx-cli/commit/929952d): Rename package to influxdb2-cli
- [3a2e139](https://github.com/influxdata/influx-cli/commit/3a2e139): Check for all available cookies instead of the count
- [467d545](https://github.com/influxdata/influx-cli/commit/467d545): Don't import non-existent/unused GPG private key
- [3a37835](https://github.com/influxdata/influx-cli/commit/3a37835): Supply "VERSION" and "COMMIT" to Makefile
- [9db72b0](https://github.com/influxdata/influx-cli/commit/9db72b0): Create errors-file if it does not exist
- [cea19bf](https://github.com/influxdata/influx-cli/commit/cea19bf): Avoid panic on empty tag value
- [4d6fac2](https://github.com/influxdata/influx-cli/commit/4d6fac2): Dbrp correct json output
- [8cdf401](https://github.com/influxdata/influx-cli/commit/8cdf401): Update fingerprint

### Features

- [bdb9324](https://github.com/influxdata/influx-cli/commit/bdb9324): Add `--operator-token` flag to restore subcommand
- [de93ca0](https://github.com/influxdata/influx-cli/commit/de93ca0): Adds gzip compression level configuration to backups for v2

### Other

- [8a2499f](https://github.com/influxdata/influx-cli/commit/8a2499f): Chore: update to go 1.20.3
- [b7eacf9](https://github.com/influxdata/influx-cli/commit/b7eacf9): Chore: use remote package signing
- [a187815](https://github.com/influxdata/influx-cli/commit/a187815): Chore: make sure .exe is on windows builds
- [e2e7fcf](https://github.com/influxdata/influx-cli/commit/e2e7fcf): Build(deps): bump golang.org/x/text from 0.3.7 to 0.3.8
- [c73d46e](https://github.com/influxdata/influx-cli/commit/c73d46e): Chore: update MacOS executor to M1
- [08605a3](https://github.com/influxdata/influx-cli/commit/08605a3): Build(deps): bump google.golang.org/protobuf from 1.30.0 to 1.33.0
- [938f6a4](https://github.com/influxdata/influx-cli/commit/938f6a4): Chore: upgrade to go 1.21.12
- [cf80a73](https://github.com/influxdata/influx-cli/commit/cf80a73): Chore: upgrade GoLang to 1.22.11
- [ba62e03](https://github.com/influxdata/influx-cli/commit/ba62e03): Chore(CI): add "influxdata-archive-keyring" package
- [80776b8](https://github.com/influxdata/influx-cli/commit/80776b8): Chore(ci): use supported macOS runner
- [4180737](https://github.com/influxdata/influx-cli/commit/4180737): Chore: update to go 1.25.7
- [7285c37](https://github.com/influxdata/influx-cli/commit/7285c37): Ci: strip release binaries
- [e8ca87e](https://github.com/influxdata/influx-cli/commit/e8ca87e): Chore: update to go 1.25.9
